reference_basis: V0.8.3 preserves the original fixed CANVAS reader shell. Universal features are mandatory for every paper; figure-study is conditional by paper type rather than globally required.

direct_use.pinned: Use branch v0.8.3 when a versioned branch name is preferred.
direct_use.stable_alias: Use branch latest as the stable alias.

universal_required_features: source-faithful English body: no AI summary or paraphrase in the bilingual reading layer
Chinese translation only: no explanation, inference, expansion or conclusion strengthening
sentence-level English-Chinese pairing and paired highlighting
terminology highlighting and clickable definitions in English; Chinese aliases are highlighted when defined
inline citation popup at the original citation position
cited reference popup exposes an external DOI/publisher/arXiv/search link
inline figure/table reference opens the corresponding asset at the original mention position
complete source English captions and complete Chinese caption translations
reference popups, annotation tools, reader settings, resizing and viewer controls
PDF-native figure/table extraction whenever the PDF exposes an image object or vector region

figure_intensive.use_for: CNS-family main/sub-journal papers and biology/bioinformatics-heavy discovery papers

conditional_figure_study.manual_override: paper-specific plan may explicitly choose standard or figure_intensive; manual override has priority

component_format_contract.principle: Paper-specific content may change, but reader component DOM, class names, typography routing and spacing primitives may not be invented per paper.

supplementary_source_contract.principle: If the article cites supplementary figures or tables that are absent from the uploaded main PDF, the builder must retrieve the final published supplementary material itself before declaring the reader complete.
requirements: use the final published supplement when available rather than an older preprint supplement
obtain the actual supplementary figure/table image or source page
verify numbering against the final article
preserve the official English caption and provide a complete Chinese caption translation
make supplementary figure/table mentions clickable at their original in-text position
include supplementary assets in the preview index and right-side viewer
if the reader profile is figure_intensive, inventory every labeled panel and meaningful unlabeled logical block before writing figure-study explanations

preferred_order: PDF vector/page clip exported as SVG

forbidden_regressions: AI-authored English summary in place of source text
paragraph-level matching in place of sentence-level pairing
citation numbers rendered as plain text without popup/link behavior
figure references moved to paragraph ends
terminology highlighting dropped from a source-faithful rebuild
figure/table preview cards or right-side viewer no longer clickable
figure-study forced onto conventional low-reading-difficulty papers
figure-study omitted from CNS-family or biology/bioinformatics-heavy figure-intensive papers
paper-specific HTML/CSS/JS generated independently instead of using the fixed reader shell
paper-specific replacement markup for fixed hero or overview components
supplementary figures omitted solely because they are not embedded in the uploaded main PDF
manual screenshot crop used when the PDF exposes an extractable image object or vector region
